# eesel AI

> > eesel AI provides AI-powered customer support automation that integrates with Zendesk, Slack, Intercom, and other platforms to deliver intelligent chatbots and knowledge base solutions.

eesel AI specializes in enterprise-grade AI customer support tools, with deep integrations for Zendesk Suite (Professional and Enterprise), Slack workflows, and knowledge management platforms like Confluence, Notion, and Google Docs. The platform emphasizes GDPR/CCPA compliance and does not train AI models on customer data.

## Key Topics

- Zendesk integration and automation
- AI customer support and chatbots
- Zendesk Guide knowledge base
- Zendesk Explore analytics and reporting
- Skills-based routing and ticket assignment
- Slack integration for support workflows
- Enterprise access control and permissions
- GDPR and CCPA compliance
- Zendesk Suite Professional and Enterprise
- Intercom and Jira Service Management integration
- Self-service automation
- Omnichannel and multichannel support
- AI agent optimization and intent recognition
- Data retention and privacy policies
- Confluence, Notion, and Google Docs connectivity
